contentDetections.title: Application debug mode marker exposed
contentDetections.detail: The response contains the custom debug-mode marker configured for this application.
contentDetections.exploit: Debug mode can reveal stack traces, source paths, configuration, and secrets when an error occurs.
contentDetections.remediation: Disable debug mode in production and return generic error pages.
contentDetections.reference: CWE-215: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Debugging Code

contentDetections.title: Exposed ACME access token
contentDetections.detail: A value matching the company's access-token format is present in browser-visible content.
contentDetections.exploit: Anyone who can load the response may be able to reuse the token against the associated service.
contentDetections.remediation: Revoke and rotate the token, remove it from client-visible files, and load it only on the server.

pathDetections.title: Internal status endpoint exposed
pathDetections.exploit: The endpoint can reveal internal services, deployment versions, or credentials useful for follow-on attacks.
pathDetections.remediation: Remove the endpoint from the public site or require authentication and return only non-sensitive health data.
